capabilities: Import multiple images at once via drag-and-drop or file selector
Create a Markdown note per image, optionally from a template
Append images to an existing note without altering its frontmatter
Compress images to JPEG with adjustable quality and size preview
Batch rename files with a common base name and numbered suffixes
extras: The README includes two personal use-case examples (trip notes, clothing catalogue) and a blog reference; the Settings section is present but empty. Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it for their own workflows: adding highlight photos to trip write-up notes and cataloguing clothes for a digital wardrobe.
problem: Manually importing many images, creating a note for each, and adding frontmatter is laborious, and linked images with existing names can cause duplicates.
summary: Bulk image importer that creates one note per image or appends images to an existing note, with optional JPEG compression and batch renaming.
